purpose: Teach: やみ/がかっ/もしや/ヒロシ/ひろし/ひろ/いじり/ココ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、やみ社会の言語を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you were writing about underground-society language in your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Lean in slightly. Affirming tone — teacher who has actually read the work. Light, inviting.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、影がかっ た光と影の効果を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on how shadow and light create different meanings in that language.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful with her words. Modest but confident. Slight pause before answering, like she's choosing precision. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もしや、新理論を立てられましたか
lines.en: So you developed a new theoretical framework?
lines.style: Gently probing, not leading. Open curiosity. Slight lift at the end of the question — inviting her to elaborate. Steady, patient.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ヒロシ・タナカ教授の論を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I built on Professor Hiroshi Tanaka's existing theory.
lines.style: Clear and grounded. Acknowledges her sources without diminishing her contribution. Slight firmness — this matters to her. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史人物ひろし王の業績を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you examined historical records and regional traditions in that work, correct?
lines.style: Confirming, affirming. A teacher checking in but already knowing the answer. Warm recognition. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ひろい地域に伝わる伝承を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I traced how those traditions spread across different regions and communities.
lines.style: Engaged now, warming up. More direct. Pride threading underneath without becoming defensive. Natural flow, settling into her topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文化財をいじり過ぎる修復を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You also looked at restoration practices — and when they risk damaging the cultural material itself?
lines.style: Slightly sharper now, more probing. Teacher bringing out the deeper implication. Thoughtful but direct. Still warm, but asking her to go further.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、南国のココナッツ農園を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, actually — I used examples from tropical agricultural communities to illustrate that tension.
lines.style: Brighten slightly. This is a moment of connection with the teacher. She's seen the depth in her own argument. Confident close, settling back.
